methods.name: from_bytes
methods.summary: Create a new candidate for matching from the given path as a sequence of bytes.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new candidate for matching from the given path.

items.name: Error
items.summary: Represents an error that can occur when parsing a glob pattern.

methods.name: glob
methods.summary: Return the glob that caused this error, if one exists.

methods.name: kind
methods.summary: Return the kind of this error.

items.name: GlobSet
items.summary: GlobSet represents a group of globs that can be matched together in a single pass.

methods.name: builder
methods.summary: Create a new [`GlobSetBuilder`]. A `GlobSetBuilder` can be used to add new patterns. Once all patterns have been added, `build` should be called to produce a `GlobSet`, which can then be used for matching.

methods.name: empty
methods.summary: Create an empty `GlobSet`. An empty set matches nothing.

methods.name: is_empty
methods.summary: Returns true if this set is empty, and therefore matches nothing.

methods.name: is_match
methods.signature: fn is_match<P: AsRef<Path>>(&self, path: P) -> bool
methods.summary: Returns true if any glob in this set matches the path given.

methods.name: is_match_candidate
methods.summary: Returns true if any glob in this set matches the path given.

methods.name: len
methods.summary: Returns the number of globs in this set.

methods.name: matches
methods.signature: fn matches<P: AsRef<Path>>(&self, path: P) -> Vec<usize>
methods.summary: Returns the sequence number of every glob pattern that matches the given path.

methods.name: matches_all
methods.signature: fn matches_all<P: AsRef<Path>>(&self, path: P) -> bool
methods.summary: Returns true if all globs in this set match the path given.

methods.name: matches_all_candidate
methods.summary: Returns true if all globs in this set match the path given.

methods.name: matches_candidate
methods.summary: Returns the sequence number of every glob pattern that matches the given path.

methods.name: matches_candidate_into
methods.summary: Adds the sequence number of every glob pattern that matches the given path to the vec given.

methods.name: matches_into
methods.signature: fn matches_into<P: AsRef<Path>>(&self, path: P, into: &mut Vec<usize>)
methods.summary: Adds the sequence number of every glob pattern that matches the given path to the vec given.

items.name: GlobSetBuilder
items.summary: GlobSetBuilder builds a group of patterns that can be used to simultaneously match a file path.

methods.signature: fn add(&mut self, pat: Glob) -> &mut GlobSetBuilder
methods.summary: Add a new pattern to this set.

methods.name: build
methods.summary: Builds a new matcher from all of the glob patterns added so far.

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new `GlobSetBuilder`. A `GlobSetBuilder` can be used to add new patterns. Once all patterns have been added, `build` should be called to produce a [`GlobSet`], which can then be used for matching.
